list.title: Gateways
list.description: Enable approved payment and SMS providers. Configure credentials and params as instructed by each gateway class. Endpoints are managed by Durpalla Admin.
list.footnote: You can remove an enabled gateway from your account. You cannot change its namespace or type. Endpoints are managed by Durpalla Admin.
